_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 4% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves over 7 days, this is a statistically verified coil where HOLD is the skilled graded call — no visible breaker has emerged and the liquidity foundation needed to validate a directional move up remains absent.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing broken analog structure and missing liquidity; narrative writer implies UP with high conviction on mean-reversion; the split is fundamental: same pattern match, opposite interpretations of its validity.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive with stablecoin growth recovering above 45 and BTC momentum sustaining above 55
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 20 with funding spiking above 0.03% and BTC momentum dropping below 42, pushing score toward Panic
